name: Ningbo Ligong Environment And Energy Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Ningbo Ligong Environment And Energy Technology Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and servicing of online monitoring equipment for the electric power industry in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Online Power Monitoring Measurement System, Electricity Cost Soft Item, Water Quality Monitoring Equipment Note, Water Quality and Air Transport Dimension, and Others segments.
